groups.name: x_reg
groups.role: input register "x" (little endian): holds x at the start, is rewritten in place by the normalisation and the square root, and is restored at the end
groups.evidence: verifier contract + register declaration in the file

groups.name: flags
groups.role: exponent flags: the even shift e (0..10) chosen by the normalisation, held for the whole body and used by the phase endpoint to rotate the quotient word; idle across most peak runs but information-bearing
groups.evidence: builder owner map at every cut (Syed Asad Ali's generator)

groups.name: root_v
groups.role: first half: the 12 square-root bits v, written in place over the top of x by the consuming square root (later some move to other wires; see each stage)

groups.name: residual_h
groups.role: first half: the 10-bit residual h of the square root, in place over the bottom of x

groups.name: coef_D1
groups.role: first table load: the 13-bit coefficient D; measured away (HMR) before the divider at op 6,707 and reloaded on other wires by the second table

groups.name: meta_H1
groups.role: first table load: metadata bits H, retired after the first coefficient; the same wires later hold seed and product bits

groups.name: scratch
groups.role: all 24 non-input wires; registers move between them stage by stage (each stage note lists the owner map at its end)
